Instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) API to view details of all AnalyticDB PostgreSQL instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

description.zh: 要重新排序的文档列表。
description.en: List of documents to be re-ordered.

description.zh:
超出模型窗口时，允许将文本切分的最大块数：
- bge-reranker-v2-m3：默认值是10。
- bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise：默认值是5：

> 切分举例
> - 如果使用bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise模型，则最大单推理窗口为2048tokens，此时如果query是48tokens，单个document参数内容为9000tokens，则会被分为：1-2000为第一个，2001-4000为第二个，以此类推，并且切分个数超过MaxChunksPerDoc后，后面的语句会被丢弃。
description.en:
Maximum number of chunks allowed when the text exceeds the model window:
- bge-reranker-v2-m3: default value is 10.
- bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise: default value is 5:

> Example of splitting
> - If using the bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise model, the maximum single inference window is 2048 tokens. If the query is 48 tokens and the content of a single document parameter is 9000 tokens, it will be divided as follows: 1-2000 for the first, 2001-4000 for the second, and so on. If the number of splits exceeds MaxChunksPerDoc, the remaining sentences will be discarded.

description.zh:
Rerank模型，目前支持
- bge-reranker-v2-m3:（默认值），性能较好，单条推理支持8192tokens，超出会被切分，效果可能下降。
- bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise：效果相比v2-m3更优，单条推理支持2048tokens，超出会被切分，效果可能下降。
description.en:
Rerank model, currently supports:
- bge-reranker-v2-m3: (default), better performance, supports 8192 tokens per inference, if exceeded, it will be split, which may reduce the effect.
- bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise: better performance than v2-m3, supports 2048 tokens per inference, if exceeded, it will be split, which may reduce the effect.
Region ID where the instance is located.

description.zh: 为false时，不返回Documents文本，仅仅返回文档排序的索引及rerank得分。
description.en: If set to false, does not return the Documents text, only returns the index of the document order and the rerank score.

description.zh: 要返回的最相关文档的数量。
description.en: Number of most relevant documents to return.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb rerank --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --query What_is_ADBPG0 --documents ADBPG是阿里云OLAP数据库。 --model bge-reranker-v2-m3 --instruct Given_a_web_search_query,_retrieve_relevant_passages_that_answer_the_query --topk 3 --return-documents false --max-chunks-per-doc 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb Rerank --region cn-hangzhou --TopK 3 --MaxChunksPerDoc 10 --Instruct 'Given_a_web_search_query,_retrieve_relevant_passages_that_answer_the_query' --Query What_is_ADBPG0 --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --ReturnDocuments false --Documents '["ADBPG是阿里云OLAP数据库。"]' --Model 'bge-reranker-v2-m3' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
